open_points.subject: judge_execution
open_points.text: - judge_execution: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] When cleanup was confirmed the outcome is the first that holds, in this order of = models.SandboxOutcome: timeout when the deadline passed; resource_exhausted when the memory, process, scratch or output bound was hit, the channel bound included; sandbox_violation when the report holds any trap hit, even if the code caught it and returned a conforming dict; crashed when the report says crashed, the runner exited abnormally, or no returned message was read — the report's returned is None: read_runner_report always gives a RunnerReport, for a channel that carried nothing one with no trap hit, no resource hit, crashed false, failure None and returned None, so the observation always holds a report; contract_violation when the returned value is not a dict with exactly the output ports, an output is not_representable, its JSON text does not give canonical JSON through canonical_bytes, or fit_port_value with bounds.output_bytes as size bound does not fit an output to its port; otherwise succeeded. The stored value and spool ceilings are applied by the module that stores or spools an output.
open_points.other_text: - ResourceBounds fields (exact, no others exist): wall_time_ms: int, memory_bytes: int, output_bytes: int, process_count: int
open_points.question: Must a scratch bound be added to ResourceBounds or supplied by an imported constant, or must the scratch-bound outcome condition be removed?
